title: Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft: Bafin imposes administrative fines
description: On 11 November 2026, the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) imposed administrative fines amounting to €8 million on Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft. The company had contravened the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG). There were shortcomings in the migration of Postbank customers to the parent company’s shared IT platform (Project Unity).
